reviews.author: AbelG

reviews.title: Integrated Graphics
reviews.comment: RAM - 32 GB  6000 MT @ CL 30 very stable with no issues. Handles overclocking well and with a MOB with good power delivery expect good stability. Graphics - Comes with RDNA 2 integrated graphics, only two cores. Able to run Apex at 1080p low with 44- 63fps. Fortnite at 1080p low 90-120fps. However it will struggle to run more GPU intensive games as it was not designed for that. Keep that in mind as this CPU truly shines when paired with descrete graphics cards. Multitasking - Found it to be fast, stable and able to play games, youtube, stream all at once with zero performance loss Cooling- Runs a bit on the hotter side due to its overclocking and high base clock. However with good airflow and an AIO mines remains less than 70 degrees even while gaming. NB this is with less than 60% cpu usage. So expect a further increase in temperature under higher usage. Overall, I m well pleased with this purchase. I highly recommend if you want good performance at a decent price.
reviews.author: Mikail

reviews.title: Good CPU for the price.
reviews.comment: I got the 7700x as a temp CPU until I get a friend's current CPU in a few months (he is upgrading). Featuring 8 cores that run up to 5.4GHz, it's a good CPU for 250 USD (at least at the time of writing it is) I don't have much to say other than whatever info you can likely find by looking at the description, so easy 5 stars because AMD is great.

reviews.comment: It does what the benchmarks say it should do. It's a great CPU. Enough said! I had no troubles with set up or getting it working at all. I have never had any real heat issues either.

reviews.title: good choice
reviews.comment: I asked for recommendations on a CPU that would be functional for both gaming and productivity, and this one was recommended to me. I've been using it for a little over six months and it performs very well. It's worth noting that these CPUs with the X suffix tend to run a bit hot, so good cooling is recommended to ensure good performance.
